environment.description: Flask application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance running as `appuser` with standard DAC permissions. No MAC framework enabled (AppArmor set to complain mode for this profile). Application runs behind nginx reverse proxy with basic rate limiting. Container uses default Docker seccomp profile. File system permissions: appuser has read access to /etc/ and write access to /var/backups/app/ and /tmp/.

config.network: nginx reverse proxy with rate limiting only
